Name: Branch to Branch
Description:
You pound your chest in primal exuberance. For the duration, you gain the following benefits:
• You gain a climbing speed equal to your movement speed.
• You gain bonus to Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks you make equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.
• You can brachiate (swing from branches and vines) at your movement speed without needing to make an ability check.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the duration is increased to 1 hour.
